description: Checks the site's robots.txt, sitemaps, llms.txt and agent manifests, and gives a robots.txt verdict for each AI crawler with its role (training, search_index or user_fetch). A missing optional file such as llms.txt is not_applicable, never a failure. Returns origin; facts (robots.txt status, Content-Signal lines, aiCrawlers each with allowed true or false for the home page, the agent files found, and the Markdown version); sitemap (the files read and the URLs listed); and findings. Each finding has checkId (a WorkPods check id), layer (seo, geo, axo), group, status (pass, partial, fail or not_applicable), severity (critical, high, medium or low on a fail or partial, null otherwise), a one-sentence summary and evidence (selector, url, value, note).

url.description: Any page on the site; only its origin is used, an absolute http or https URL such as https://example.com/.

name: site_files
title: Check site files
